mapper.select:
select `cbg`.`id`, `cbg`.`name`, `cbg`.`remark` from `center_biz_group` `cbg` inner join `center_biz_tag_ref` `cbtr` on `cbg`.`id` = `cbtr`.`business_key` inner join `center_biz_tag` `cbt` on `cbtr`.tag_id = `cbt`.id
`cbt`.`tag_code` = #{param.tagCode}
and `cbg`.`name` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
order by `cbg`.`update_time` desc
